<script>
/* Alto real de la ventana para los paneles fijos. Se ignoran los cambios chicos de la barra del navegador móvil
   (evita saltos al hacer scroll) y se actualiza al rotar o al cambiar el tamaño de la vista (p. ej. el editor de Elementor). */
(function(){var de=document.documentElement;function tier(){var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight,land=W>H,t;
  if(land&&H<=500)t='t-pl';else if(!land&&W<600)t='t-ph';else if(!land)t='t-tab';else if(W>=1600)t='t-xl';else t='t-std';
  ['t-ph','t-pl','t-tab','t-std','t-xl'].forEach(function(c){de.classList.toggle(c,c===t);});
  de.classList.toggle('t-short',H<(t==='t-ph'?700:800));}
  tier();addEventListener('resize',tier);addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){setTimeout(tier,250);});})();
(function(){var de=document.documentElement,w=0,hh=0;function set(){var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;if(W!==w||Math.abs(H-hh)>120||!hh){w=W;hh=H;de.style.setProperty('--mgvh',H+'px');}}
set();addEventListener('resize',set);addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){setTimeout(set,250);});})();
</script>

  const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}}),{rootMargin:'0px 0px -12% 0px'});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-rv]').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

  /* ── Diagnóstico express ───────────── */
  const REC={
    mnt:{k:'Equipo',t:'Mantenimiento predictivo',r:'Las señales de tus equipos críticos.',p:'Un circuito de celdas de flotación.',chip:'i-mnt'},
    bio:{k:'Pila',t:'Biolixiviación genómica',r:'Muestras microbianas y soluciones de tu pila.',p:'Un sector de la pila.',chip:'i-bio'},
    geo:{k:'Territorio',t:'Exploración geoespacial',r:'Imágenes satelitales, geología y terreno.',p:'Un sector o un talud.',chip:'i-geo'},
    twin:{k:'Planta',t:'Modelo 3D de planta (BIM)',r:'Planos, modelos y datos de operación.',p:'Un circuito o un área.',chip:'i-twin'}
  };
  const pains=[...document.querySelectorAll('.pain')];
  function pick(key,focus){
    pains.forEach(b=>{const on=b.dataset.pain===key;b.setAttribute('aria-checked',on);b.tabIndex=on?0:-1;if(on&&focus)b.focus();});
    const r=REC[key];

    document.getElementById('recT').textContent=r.t;
    document.getElementById('recR').textContent=r.r;
    document.getElementById('recP').textContent=r.p;

  pains.forEach((b,i)=>{
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>pick(b.dataset.pain));
    b.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{let j=null;if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowRight')j=(i+1)%pains.length;if(e.key==='ArrowUp'||e.key==='ArrowLeft')j=(i+pains.length-1)%pains.length;if(j!==null){e.preventDefault();pick(pains[j].dataset.pain,true);}});
  });
  pick('mnt');
  const topicMap={'Mantenimiento predictivo':'mnt','Biolixiviación genómica':'bio','Exploración geoespacial':'geo','Modelo 3D de planta':'twin'};
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-topic]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{const k=topicMap[a.dataset.topic];if(k)pick(k);}));

  /* ── Formulario ────────────────────── */
  const form=document.getElementById('form'),steps=[...form.querySelectorAll('.fstep')],done=document.getElementById('done');
  const stepLbl=document.getElementById('stepLbl'),stepBar=document.getElementById('stepBar');
  function show(n){steps.forEach(s=>s.hidden=+s.dataset.step!==n);done.hidden=true;stepLbl.textContent='Paso '+n+' de 2';stepBar.style.right=n===1?'50%':'0%';}
  document.getElementById('to2').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const any=form.querySelectorAll('input[name="interes"]:checked').length;
    const m=document.getElementById('msg1');
    if(!any){m.textContent='Elige al menos una opción. Si no estás seguro, marca «Aún no lo sé».';return;}
    m.textContent='';show(2);document.getElementById('f-name').focus();
  });
  document.getElementById('to1').addEventListener('click',()=>show(1));
  document.getElementById('edit').addEventListener('click',()=>show(2));
  form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const g=id=>document.getElementById(id).value.trim();
    const m=document.getElementById('msg2');
    if(!g('f-name')||!g('f-co')){m.textContent='Nos falta tu nombre y tu empresa o faena.';return;}
    if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(g('f-mail'))){m.textContent='Revisa el correo; debería verse así: nombre@empresa.cl.';document.getElementById('f-mail').focus();return;}
    m.textContent='';
    const ints=[...form.querySelectorAll('input[name="interes"]:checked')].map(i=>i.value).join(', ');
    const etapa=form.querySelector('input[name="etapa"]:checked').value;
    const body=['Solicitud de diagnóstico operativo','','Interés: '+ints,'Etapa: '+etapa,'Problema: '+(g('f-msg')||'—'),'','Nombre: '+g('f-name'),'Cargo: '+(g('f-role')||'—'),'Empresa / faena: '+g('f-co'),'Teléfono: '+(g('f-tel')||'—'),'Correo: '+g('f-mail')].join('\n');
    document.getElementById('sum').textContent=body;
    document.getElementById('mailto').href='mailto:contacto@metalgenomic.cl?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Diagnóstico operativo · '+g('f-co'))+'&body='+encodeURIComponent(body);
    steps.forEach(s=>s.hidden=true);done.hidden=false;stepLbl.textContent='Listo';stepBar.style.right='0%';done.focus();
    try{const mt=document.getElementById('mailto').href;setTimeout(()=>{window.location.href=mt;},60);}catch(_){}
  });
  function copy(text,btn,ok){
    const done=()=>{const o=btn.textContent;btn.textContent=ok;setTimeout(()=>btn.textContent=o,1800);};
    if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done,()=>sel());}else sel();
    function sel(){const r=document.createRange();const el=btn.id==='copyMail'?document.getElementById('mailTxt'):document.getElementById('sum');r.selectNodeContents(el);const s=getSelection();s.removeAllRanges();s.addRange(r);btn.textContent='Texto seleccionado';}
  }
  document.getElementById('copySum').addEventListener('click',e=>copy(document.getElementById('sum').textContent,e.currentTarget,'Copiada'));
  document.getElementById('copyMail').addEventListener('click',e=>copy('contacto@metalgenomic.cl',e.currentTarget,'Copiado'));
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ── Cierre: la veta de cobre que conduce al siguiente paso ──────────────────
   SVG + CSS + GSAP (ya cargado). Una veta luminosa nace en el borde de la sección,
   recorre el espacio y rodea el botón principal; el título entra palabra por palabra.
   Decoración con aria-hidden y pointer-events:none: nunca bloquea clics. */
(function(){
  const card=document.querySelector('#preguntas .card');if(!card)return;
  const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const h2=card.querySelector('.display'),btn=card.querySelector('.btn'),mail=card.querySelector('.mail'),sec=card.closest('section');
  const txt=h2.textContent.trim();h2.setAttribute('aria-label',txt);
  h2.innerHTML=txt.split(/\s+/).map(w=>'<span class="vw'+(/^(operaci|dato)/i.test(w)?' vw--op':'')+'" aria-hidden="true">'+w+'</span>').join(' ');
  const words=[...h2.querySelectorAll('.vw')];
  const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.setAttribute('class','vein');svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');svg.setAttribute('focusable','false');
  svg.innerHTML='<defs><linearGradient id="veinG" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a4a2c"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#e3955c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffd2a1"/></linearGradient></defs>'+
    '<g class="vein__twigs"></g><path class="vein__glow"/><path class="vein__core"/><g class="vein__dots"></g>';
  card.prepend(svg);
  const glow=svg.querySelector('.vein__glow'),core=svg.querySelector('.vein__core'),twigs=svg.querySelector('.vein__twigs'),dots=svg.querySelector('.vein__dots'),grad=svg.querySelector('#veinG');
  let len=0,ring=null,state='idle';
  function rnd(seed){let a=seed;return()=>{a=(a*16807)%2147483647;return a/2147483647;};}
  function build(){
    const cr=card.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=sec.getBoundingClientRect(),br=btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    const W=sr.width,H=cr.height,ox=sr.left-cr.left;
    svg.style.left=ox+'px';svg.setAttribute('width',W);svg.setAttribute('height',H);svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 '+W+' '+H);
    const pad=10,L=br.left-sr.left-pad,R=br.right-sr.left+pad,T=br.top-cr.top-pad,B=br.bottom-cr.top+pad,r=(B-T)/2,cx=(L+R)/2,cy=(T+B)/2;
    const narrow=W<600,rr=rnd(7);
    // veta: nace en el borde de la sección y avanza sin cruzar el título; se calma al llegar al botón
    const hb=h2.getBoundingClientRect().bottom-cr.top+14,ex=L,ey=cy;
    let d,pts;
    if(narrow){
      // celular: baja pegada al margen izquierdo y gira hacia el botón
      const x0=Math.max(6,W*.04);d='M'+x0.toFixed(1)+' 0';pts=[[x0,0]];const N=5;
      for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const y=(cy-36)*i/N,x=x0+(rr()-.5)*10;const p=pts[pts.length-1];d+=' Q'+(p[0]+(rr()-.5)*14).toFixed(1)+' '+((p[1]+y)/2).toFixed(1)+' '+x.toFixed(1)+' '+y.toFixed(1);pts.push([x,y]);}
      const p=pts[pts.length-1];d+=' Q'+p[0].toFixed(1)+' '+ey.toFixed(1)+' '+ex.toFixed(1)+' '+ey.toFixed(1);pts.push([ex,ey]);
    }else{
      // computador y iPad: entra desde el borde izquierdo por debajo del título
      const lo=Math.min(hb,cy-6),hi=H-14,sx=0,sy=Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,cy+(H-cy)*.35));d='M0 '+sy.toFixed(1);pts=[[sx,sy]];const N=6;
      for(let i=1;i<=N;i++){const f=i/N,amp=(1-f*f)*Math.min(70,(hi-lo)*.45);
        const bx=sx+(ex-sx)*f,by=sy+(ey-sy)*f,ny=i===N?ey:Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,by+(rr()-.5)*2*amp)),nx=i===N?ex:bx;
        const p=pts[pts.length-1],cxq=(p[0]+nx)/2,cyq=Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,p[1]+(rr()-.5)*amp));
        d+=' Q'+cxq.toFixed(1)+' '+cyq.toFixed(1)+' '+nx.toFixed(1)+' '+ny.toFixed(1);pts.push([nx,ny]);}
    }
    // la veta rodea el botón (cápsula) entrando por su costado izquierdo
    const ringD=' A'+r+' '+r+' 0 0 1 '+(L+r).toFixed(1)+' '+T.toFixed(1)+' H'+(R-r).toFixed(1)+' A'+r+' '+r+' 0 0 1 '+(R-r).toFixed(1)+' '+B.toFixed(1)+' H'+(L+r).toFixed(1)+' A'+r+' '+r+' 0 0 1 '+L.toFixed(1)+' '+cy.toFixed(1);
    const sx=pts[0][0],sy=pts[0][1];
    glow.setAttribute('d',d+ringD);core.setAttribute('d',d+ringD);
    grad.setAttribute('x1',sx);grad.setAttribute('y1',sy);grad.setAttribute('x2',cx);grad.setAttribute('y2',cy);
    // ramificaciones finas, como una veta mineral
    let tw='';for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){const [x,y]=pts[i],a=narrow?(rr()-.5)*1.2:rr()*Math.PI*2,l=narrow?10+rr()*14:18+rr()*36;tw+='<path class="vein__twig" d="M'+x.toFixed(1)+' '+y.toFixed(1)+' q'+(Math.cos(a)*l*.5).toFixed(1)+' '+(Math.sin(a)*l*.5+6).toFixed(1)+' '+(Math.cos(a)*l).toFixed(1)+' '+(Math.sin(a)*l).toFixed(1)+'"/>';}
    twigs.innerHTML=tw;
    len=core.getTotalLength();
    [glow,core].forEach(p=>{p.style.strokeDasharray=len;if(state==='idle'&&!reduce)p.style.strokeDashoffset=len;else p.style.strokeDashoffset=0;});
    twigs.style.opacity=(state==='idle'&&!reduce)?0:1;
    ring={L,R,T,B,r,cx,cy};
  }
  function ringPoint(k,n){const {L,R,T,B,r,cx,cy}=ring;const a=k/n*Math.PI*2;const rx=(R-L)/2,ry=(B-T)/2;return[cx+Math.cos(a)*rx,cy+Math.sin(a)*ry];}
  function particles(){
    if(!ring)return;const g=window.gsap;dots.innerHTML='';const n=26;
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const c=document.createElementNS(NS,'circle');const [tx,ty]=ringPoint(i,n);const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,dd=110+Math.random()*170;
      c.setAttribute('cx',(ring.cx+Math.cos(a)*dd).toFixed(1));c.setAttribute('cy',(ring.cy+Math.sin(a)*dd*.6).toFixed(1));c.setAttribute('r',(1+Math.random()*1.8).toFixed(2));c.style.opacity=0;dots.appendChild(c);
      if(g)g.timeline().to(c,{opacity:.95,duration:.25,delay:i*.012}).to(c,{attr:{cx:tx,cy:ty},duration:1.1,ease:'power3.inOut'},'<').to(c,{opacity:0,attr:{r:.6},duration:.7,ease:'power1.out'});}
  }
  function finish(){state='done';card.classList.add('card--done');[glow,core].forEach(p=>p.style.strokeDashoffset=0);twigs.style.opacity=1;}
  function play(){
    if(state!=='idle')return;state='run';
    const g=window.gsap;
    if(reduce||!g){finish();words.forEach(w=>{w.style.opacity=1;});mail.style.opacity=1;return;}
    const tl=g.timeline();
    tl.fromTo(words,{yPercent:70,opacity:0},{yPercent:0,opacity:1,duration:1,ease:'power4.out',stagger:.09},0)
      .to([glow,core],{strokeDashoffset:0,duration:2.6,ease:'power2.inOut'},.25)
      .to(twigs,{opacity:1,duration:.8},1.6)
      .add(()=>{card.classList.add('card--flash','card--done');particles();},2.75)
      .add(()=>{card.classList.remove('card--flash');card.classList.add('card--pulse');state='done';},4.1)
      .fromTo(mail,{y:14,opacity:0},{y:0,opacity:1,duration:1,ease:'power4.out'},3.2);
  }
  if(!reduce&&window.gsap){words.forEach(w=>w.style.opacity=0);mail.style.opacity=0;}
  else if(!reduce){/* GSAP aún no está: se ocultan con CSS al iniciar la secuencia */}
  const hot=on=>card.classList.toggle('card--hot',on);
  btn.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>hot(true));btn.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>hot(false));
  btn.addEventListener('focus',()=>hot(true));btn.addEventListener('blur',()=>hot(false));
  btn.addEventListener('touchstart',()=>{hot(true);setTimeout(()=>hot(false),900);},{passive:true});
  build();
  let rt=0;addEventListener('resize',()=>{clearTimeout(rt);rt=setTimeout(build,120);});
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready)document.fonts.ready.then(build);
  const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){io.disconnect();if(!reduce&&window.gsap){words.forEach(w=>w.style.opacity=0);mail.style.opacity=0;}play();}}),{threshold:.35});
  io.observe(card);
})();
</script>

<script>
(async()=>{'use strict';
/* ── Cargador de three.js sin importmap ──────────────────────────
   Descarga cada módulo desde la CDN, reescribe sus importaciones ('three' y rutas relativas)
   a URLs blob y lo importa. Todos los complementos comparten una única instancia de three.js.
   Funciona aunque la página tenga otro importmap, módulos previos u optimizadores de JS. */
const MG_CDN=['https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/','https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/'];
const mgBlobs=window.__mgBlobs||(window.__mgBlobs=new Map());// compartido entre re-pintados: una sola instancia de three.js
function mgBlob(base,path){
  const key=base+path;if(mgBlobs.has(key))return mgBlobs.get(key);
  const job=(async()=>{
    const r=await fetch(key,{mode:'cors',credentials:'omit'});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status+' '+key);
    let src=await r.text();
    const re=/((?:\bimport|\bexport)\b[^'";]*?\bfrom\s*|\bimport\s*\(\s*|\bimport\s+)(['"])([^'"]+)\2/g;
    const specs=new Set();let m;while((m=re.exec(src)))specs.add(m[3]);
    const map={};
    await Promise.all([...specs].map(async s=>{
      const p=s==='three'?'build/three.module.min.js':(s.startsWith('.')?new URL(s,key).href.slice(base.length):null);
      if(p)map[s]=await mgBlob(base,p);}));
    src=src.replace(re,(all,pre,q,s)=>map[s]?pre+q+map[s]+q:all);
    return URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src],{type:'text/javascript'}));
  })();
  mgBlobs.set(key,job);return job;
}
async function mgImport(path){
  let err;for(const base of MG_CDN){try{return await import(await mgBlob(base,path));}catch(e){err=e;}}
  throw err;
}

/* ═══ MetalGenomic · escenas 3D nítidas ═════════════════════════════════════
   Geometría real (no raymarching) dibujada a la resolución nativa de la pantalla,
   con antialiasing, sombras y luz de día despejada.
   Mundo exterior: territorio → rajo → faena / BIM → pila con riego → planta.
   Interior: nave de electroobtención con puente grúa birriel.               */
const M=window.__mg;
let THREE=null,FX=null,LN=null;
if(M&&!M.dead()){
  try{THREE=await mgImport('build/three.module.min.js');}catch(e){}
  if(THREE)try{const l=await Promise.all(['Line2','LineGeometry','LineMaterial'].map(n=>mgImport('examples/jsm/lines/'+n+'.js')));LN={Line2:l[0].Line2,LineGeometry:l[1].LineGeometry,LineMaterial:l[2].LineMaterial};}catch(e){LN=null;}
  if(THREE&&!/[?&]fx=0\b/.test(location.search)){
    try{const m=await Promise.all(['EffectComposer','RenderPass','UnrealBloomPass','SSAOPass','BokehPass','OutputPass','ShaderPass'].map(n=>mgImport('examples/jsm/postprocessing/'+n+'.js')));
      FX={EffectComposer:m[0].EffectComposer,RenderPass:m[1].RenderPass,UnrealBloomPass:m[2].UnrealBloomPass,SSAOPass:m[3].SSAOPass,BokehPass:m[4].BokehPass,OutputPass:m[5].OutputPass,ShaderPass:m[6].ShaderPass};}
    catch(e){FX=null;}
  }
  if(!THREE)M.nogl('no se pudo cargar el motor 3D');
  else{try{start();}catch(e){console.warn(e);M.nogl('error al iniciar la escena 3D');}}
}

function start(){
const {small,forceGL,cv}=M;
const qs=location.search;
let R;
try{R=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:cv,antialias:true,alpha:false,powerPreference:'high-performance',failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat:!forceGL});}
catch(e){try{R=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:cv,antialias:true,alpha:false,powerPreference:'high-performance'});}catch(e2){M.nogl('sin WebGL');return;}}
// re-pintado del editor: se libera el contexto de la instancia anterior
if(window.__mgR&&window.__mgR!==R){try{window.__mgR.dispose();window.__mgR.forceContextLoss();}catch(e){}}window.__mgR=R;
const glc=R.getContext();const dbg=glc.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
const ren=dbg?String(glc.getParameter(dbg.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL)):'';
if(!forceGL&&/swiftshader|llvmpipe|softpipe|software|basic render/i.test(ren)){R.dispose();M.nogl('renderizador por software: '+ren);return;}
R.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
R.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;R.toneMappingExposure=.95;
R.shadowMap.enabled=true;R.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
const prFixed=(qs.match(/[?&]pr=([\d.]+)/)||[])[1];
const DPR=window.devicePixelRatio||1,maxPR=Math.min(DPR,2);
// v16 · piso de nitidez: nunca por debajo de 1,5 en pantallas de alta densidad (1 en pantallas 1×);
// si el equipo no da, primero se apagan efectos (SSAO, bloom), nunca la resolución bajo el piso.
const prFloor=prFixed?+prFixed:Math.min(maxPR,DPR>=1.5?1.5:1);
let PR=prFixed?+prFixed:maxPR;
function nativeFlag(){document.documentElement.classList.toggle('gl-native',Math.abs(PR-DPR)<.01);}
R.setPixelRatio(PR);R.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight,false);nativeFlag();
const ANI=R.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
const V3=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const C=h=>new THREE.Color(h);
const sm=(a,b,x)=>{const t=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t);};
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;

/* ── ruido determinista ── */
function mulberry(a){return()=>{a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
const rnd=mulberry(20251006);
const PERM=new Uint8Array(512);{const p=[...Array(256).keys()];for(let i=255;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(rnd()*(i+1));[p[i],p[j]]=[p[j],p[i]];}for(let i=0;i<512;i++)PERM[i]=p[i&255];}
function vn(x,y){const xi=Math.floor(x),yi=Math.floor(y),xf=x-xi,yf=y-yi,u=xf*xf*(3-2*xf),v=yf*yf*(3-2*yf),X=xi&255,Y=yi&255;
  const h=(i,j)=>PERM[PERM[(X+i)&255]+((Y+j)&255)]/255;
  return (h(0,0)*(1-u)+h(1,0)*u)*(1-v)+(h(0,1)*(1-u)+h(1,1)*u)*v;}
function fbm(x,y,o=5){let a=.5,f=1,s=0,n=0;for(let i=0;i<o;i++){s+=a*vn(x*f+i*17.3,y*f-i*9.1);n+=a;a*=.5;f*=2.03;}return s/n;}
const ridged=(x,y)=>{let s=0,a=.5,f=1;for(let i=0;i<5;i++){s+=a*(1-Math.abs(2*vn(x*f+i*5.1,y*f)-1));a*=.5;f*=2.1;}return s;};

/* ── texturas de detalle (nitidez a corta distancia) ── */
function canvasTex(w,h,draw,srgb=true,rep=1){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;const g=c.getContext('2d');draw(g,w,h);
  const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);if(srgb)t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;t.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;t.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;t.generateMipmaps=true;t.anisotropy=ANI;t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;t.repeat.set(rep,rep);t.userData.canvas=c;t.userData.g=g;return t;}
const detail=canvasTex(256,256,(g,w,h)=>{const im=g.createImageData(w,h);
  for(let y=0;y<h;y++)for(let x=0;x<w;x++){const n=.55*vn(x/6,y/6)+.3*vn(x/2.2+40,y/2.2)+.15*rnd();const v=Math.round(200+55*n);const i=(y*w+x)*4;im.data[i]=v;im.data[i+1]=v;im.data[i+2]=v;im.data[i+3]=255;}
  g.putImageData(im,0,0);});
const rock=canvasTex(256,256,(g,w,h)=>{g.fillStyle='#bdbdbd';g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);

<script>
/* Scroll suave: la rueda y el trackpad interpolan la posición en vez de saltar por líneas,

(function(){

  let target=scrollY,pos=scrollY,set=-1,raf=0,last=0,anim=null,padT=-1e4;

  function tick(now){

    const dt=last?Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000):1/60;last=now;

      let f=document.getElementById('mgFade');if(!f){f=document.createElement('div');f.id='mgFade';f.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
